model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each criterion as relevant. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Criterion” with values including “Relevant FCs”, “FC Summary”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Overall Summary”, “Filters”, and “Veracity Explanation”, listed in descending order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a single horizontal bar of a distinct shade of teal. The bar for “Relevant FCs” is the longest, extending to a value of 6, while the bars for “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” are the shortest, each reaching a value of 1. “FC Summary” has a length corresponding to 5 participants, and “Relevance Explanation” and "Clarity and Simplicity” both correspond to 3 participants; “Overall Summary” corresponds to a value of 2. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
